Uttar Pradesh UP Scholarship Online Form 2026-27 - Complete Details

Uttar Pradesh UP Scholarship Online Form 2026-27. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 21 September 2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start : 22 July 2026
  • Registration Last Date : 21 September 2026
  • Last Date For Form Complete : 21 September 2026
  • Last Date For Submission of Hard Copy To College : As per Schedule
  • Correction Date : As per Schedule

Application Fee

  • No Fee

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Uttar Pradesh UP Scholarship Online Form 2026-27?

Uttar Pradesh UP Scholarship Online Form 2026-27 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 21 September 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://scholarship.up.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
